tier_rule_definition: A side (exposures/outcomes) is PRESENT if any row on it has status=present with a non-null key and confident=true; else MODALITY if any row has status=modality with a non-null analogue_key and confident=true; else unreachable. A=both PRESENT; B=one PRESENT one MODALITY; C=exactly one side reachable; D=neither. Bare-status reading (confident conjunct dropped) gives C=8 D=5, moving one paper from D to C; the key/analogue_key conjunct never discriminates on this inventory.
